findings.explanation: The SPL has no duration or sustained condition; it filters individual samples first, so `avg_loss` and `avg_jitter` are averages of only the bad samples and look worse than the stream really is (implementation vs spl).
findings.suggested_fix: Average over all samples per stream per window and then compare to 1% and 40 ms, or add a consecutive-window requirement.

findings.explanation: RTP loss and jitter are not exposed by standard NVR APIs; no probe tool or export is named, so the sourcetype `nvr:rtsp` cannot be built from this text.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the probe or VMS feature that emits rtp_packet_loss_pct and rtp_jitter_ms and its sampling interval.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Thresholds loss>1% and jitter>40 ms are unexplained and not tied to stream bitrate or codec.

summary: Sustained-loss alerting is promised but not implemented, averages are taken only over breaching samples, and the RTP statistics source is not identified.
